caption: Descriptor-guided chemical space partitioning with a verified neutral ibuprofen illustration. TPSA region 1 activates KAN and MolLogP region 5 activates MLP under the locked branch allocations.

Fixed TPSA and MolLogP partitions in the ZINC15 250k pretraining corpus. Region occupancy and standardized chemical profiles use the complete corpus. The joint distribution and descriptor correlations use a deterministic 10\% sample for visualization.

Placement of descriptor-conditioned computation. The left panel reports five-fold dataset means with sample standard deviations. The right panel reports the eight-dataset macro ROC-AUC and the difference from final-layer placement.

Single-branch KAN screening for TPSA and MolLogP. Bars report the eight-dataset macro change relative to the matched all-MLP model. The overlaid curves report pretraining-corpus occupancy, and green bars identify the positive macro changes used for branch selection.
Legacy eight-layer-aligned downstream snapshot. Points report five-fold dataset means with sample standard deviations, and the lower panels report matched differences from the local Base.

Conditional component effects under the legacy eight-layer protocol. Points are matched macro AUC differences and error bars are 95\% hierarchical bootstrap intervals over datasets and scaffold folds.

t-SNE visualization of Tox21 fold-1 molecular embeddings. Each panel contains the same 768 molecules, and color denotes the descriptor region. Quantitative comparisons use the PCA-space metrics in Table~\ref{tab:embedding-metrics}.

Matched downstream macro ROC-AUC as a function of analytical active feed-forward computation and recovered active pretraining time. Point area denotes analytical stored model parameters. KAN FLOPs are architecture-based lower bounds.
Downstream classification datasets and the local evaluation protocol. Each scaffold split uses seeds 42, 43, 44, 45, and 46.
Occupancy and selected chemical characteristics of the fixed descriptor intervals in the ZINC15 250k pretraining corpus. Values in the final four columns are region means.
Historical layer-placement screening. Macro ROC-AUC gives equal weight to the eight classification datasets. Dataset-level values are provided in the Supporting Information.

Single-branch KAN screening after fixing the last-layer placement. A branch is assigned KAN when its eight-task macro AUC is higher than the matched all-MLP branch baseline. Delta is reported in percentage points.

Legacy eight-layer-aligned downstream snapshot. Values are five-fold ROC-AUC mean $\pm$ sample SD. All model and dataset cells contain five folds. Macro values are equal-weight means of the eight dataset means.
Published MoleSG and local Base results. The published values summarize three runs. The local values summarize five scaffold seeds. They are displayed as separate protocols and are not pooled.

Conditional ablation contrasts under the legacy eight-layer protocol. Macro deltas and hierarchical bootstrap intervals are reported in AUC percentage points. The interval resamples datasets and matched folds 10,000 times.

Analytical model complexity and observed successful-job runtime. Stored totals use the shared non-FFN parameter count plus the implemented branch parameters. Active FFN parameters for mixed models are occupancy-weighted. KAN FLOPs exclude spline-basis evaluation overhead. Finetuning times describe Slurm accounting records and are not a controlled architecture benchmark.
Descriptor-region separation in existing Tox21 fold-1 molecular embeddings. Distances and clustering indices are calculated after model-specific PCA and L2 normalization.

TPSA and MolLogP distributions in a deterministic 10\% sample of the ZINC15 250k pretraining corpus. Vertical lines mark the fixed interval boundaries. The joint panel shows that the two descriptor axes are related but not interchangeable.

Layer-placement screening across the eight classification datasets. The left panel reports absolute five-fold ROC-AUC. The right panel reports the difference from final-layer conditioning in AUC percentage points.
Absolute ROC-AUC for the TPSA single-branch KAN screening models. Rows identify the branch replaced by KAN.
TPSA single-branch KAN differences from the matched all-MLP final-layer model. Values are AUC percentage points.
Absolute ROC-AUC for the MolLogP single-branch KAN screening models. Rows identify the branch replaced by KAN.
MolLogP single-branch KAN differences from the matched all-MLP final-layer model. Values are AUC percentage points.
TPSA legacy eight-layer fold-level ROC-AUC values for the five main model roles on each downstream dataset.
MolLogP legacy eight-layer fold-level ROC-AUC values for the five main model roles on each downstream dataset.
Auxiliary depth, learned-routing, and all-KAN controls under their recorded protocols. Blank cells contain fewer than five folds.
Recovered TPSA terminal-batch composite-loss and active epoch-time traces. Time curves show 11-epoch rolling medians and interquartile bands after deterministic timing exclusions.
Recovered MolLogP terminal-batch composite-loss and active epoch-time traces. Separate graph reconstruction, SMILES MLM, and ConLoss epoch series were not available in the stored logs.

Observed completed legacy eight-layer finetuning job time by dataset. A submitted job could skip existing fold files, so the distribution is used for resource accounting rather than architecture-speed claims.
Five-fold descriptor-region separation metrics across the eight downstream datasets. A cell is reported only when all five fold embeddings are available.
BBBP fold-1 t-SNE comparison. All panels within a descriptor row use the same common SMILES set.
Tox21 fold-1 t-SNE comparison including the local Base.
ToxCast fold-1 t-SNE comparison.
SIDER fold-1 t-SNE comparison.
ClinTox fold-1 t-SNE comparison.
BACE fold-1 t-SNE comparison.
HIV fold-1 t-SNE comparison using a deterministic descriptor-region-stratified sample of the common molecules.
MUV fold-1 t-SNE comparison using a deterministic descriptor-region-stratified sample of the common molecules.
Complete chemical profiles of the fixed descriptor-defined regions in the ZINC15 250k pretraining corpus. Values after occupancy are region means.
Complete layer-placement screening results. Values are five-fold ROC-AUC mean $\pm$ sample SD under the historical design-selection protocol.
TPSA single-branch KAN screening. Values are ROC-AUC mean $\pm$ sample SD. Macro averages give equal weight to the eight dataset means.
\MolLogP single-branch KAN screening. Values are ROC-AUC mean $\pm$ sample SD. Macro averages give equal weight to the eight dataset means.
TPSA single-branch KAN differences relative to the matching all-MLP model. Values are AUC percentage points.
\MolLogP single-branch KAN differences relative to the matching all-MLP model. Values are AUC percentage points.
TPSA legacy eight-layer aligned fold-level results. Every model and dataset cell contains folds 1 through 5.
MolLogP legacy eight-layer aligned fold-level results. Every model and dataset cell contains folds 1 through 5.
TPSA per-dataset conditional ablation differences. Values are matched AUC percentage points.
MolLogP per-dataset conditional ablation differences. Values are matched AUC percentage points.
Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on complete shared-dataset mean differences. Holm adjustment was applied across all ten comparisons.

Auxiliary depth and learned-routing controls. Empty cells contain fewer than five completed folds. Routed models replace FFNs across all layers and are not layer-matched causal controls for MoFE-last.
Descriptor-region separation metrics across all available embedding folds. Means and sample SDs are shown only for complete five-fold entries.

Recovered active pretraining time. The first epoch of each Slurm segment and high-duration values above the segment-specific $Q_3+3\,\mathrm{IQR}$ outer fence are excluded. Scheduler wait between segments is not included. Projected active hours equal the retained median multiplied by 300.
Observed downstream Slurm accounting. A job may skip existing fold files, so these values describe execution history rather than a controlled architecture benchmark.
Definitions of evaluation metrics and derived quantities used in the main text and Supporting Information.
